entity.name: J. Torres
entity.additional_context: Frequent flyer, 47 flights in the last 12 months. No prior compensation claims this year.

triggering_event.description: Passenger successfully rebooked from cancelled UA 457 to AA 104. Airline-initiated cancellation triggers compensation eligibility per COMP-MATRIX-v3.2.
triggering_event.root_cause: Mechanical issue on UA 457 caused airline-initiated cancellation within 24 hours of departure.
triggering_event.policy_reference: COMP-MATRIX-v3.2, Section 4.1 — Airline-initiated cancellation, Gold tier

actions_completed: Passenger preferences collected (morning flight, arrive JFK by 18:00)
Fare difference of +$17.00 acknowledged and settled
Rebooking executed — new confirmation: AA 104, seat 14A
resolution_state.current_state: Passenger is rebooked and confirmed on AA 104. Compensation has not yet been processed.
remaining_steps: Determine compensation entitlements per COMP-MATRIX-v3.2, Section 4.1
Issue $200 travel credit (cancellation within 24h of departure)
Issue lounge access voucher (Gold tier entitlement)
Assess meal voucher eligibility (delay > 4 hours from original departure)
Send confirmation summary to passenger email

recipient_instructions.primary_objective: Process all eligible compensation for airline-initiated cancellation per Gold tier entitlements.
constraints: Follow COMP-MATRIX-v3.2 exactly — do not improvise amounts
Travel credit must be issued to passenger's loyalty account, not as a refund
Lounge access voucher is for departure airport (SFO) day-of-travel only
All compensation requires passenger confirmation before processing
Log all issued compensation to audit trail
recipient_instructions.eligibility_details: Gold tier + airline-initiated cancellation within 24h of departure. Eligible for: $200 travel credit, lounge access voucher, meal voucher (if delay > 4h). See COMP-MATRIX-v3.2 Section 4.1.
recipient_instructions.escalation_criteria: Escalate to human supervisor if passenger disputes compensation amount or requests compensation not covered by the matrix.
recipient_instructions.timeout_sla: Complete compensation processing within 10 minutes of handoff.

context_for_recipient.customer_emotional_state: Mildly frustrated but cooperative. Expressed relief after rebooking was completed. Tone improved significantly after being offered the earlier AA 104 flight.
context_for_recipient.interaction_history: Passenger initiated chat at 22:15Z. Rebooking completed in ~10 minutes. Passenger was responsive and decisive — selected first recommended option. No escalation requests.
context_for_recipient.tone_guidance: Maintain the positive momentum from the successful rebooking. Be proactive in listing all entitlements. Frame compensation as something the passenger has earned, not a concession.
